meta.source: Measured from screenshots of the Claude desktop app (light, text size and dark), October 2026. The artifact pane draws dark colors about a third lighter than set, so dark surface, line and link values are set lower to land on the app's colors in the pane.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Matches the chat column beside the pane, so the seam disappears. Measured #ffffff.

tokens.name: bg-canvas
tokens.usage: Workspace preset only: the grey canvas behind the white panels, never behind the nav. Set to #f3f3f1 so it shows as the viewer's #f5f5f3 in the pane; dark assumed.

tokens.name: bg-panel
tokens.usage: Workspace preset only: the nav sidebar and the panels. The viewer's off-white, measured #fdfcfd; dark same as bg.

tokens.name: bg-nav
tokens.usage: Workspace preset only: the left nav sidebar, a shade under the panels. Picked by eye, #fcfcfb.

tokens.name: bg-band
tokens.usage: Full width layout: site bands in a Split list and the detail column behind the record. Measured #fafaf9 from the design system viewer's file view.

tokens.name: bg-row
tokens.usage: Full width layout: Split list rows, the tracker bar, and the docked decision bar's box.

tokens.name: bg-sidebar
tokens.usage: A side rail or index column inside a tool. Measured #fbfbfb.

tokens.name: bg-muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: a quoted block, a code block, the progress track. Measured from the user message bubble.

tokens.name: bg-button
tokens.usage: Filled secondary button. Measured from the app's update button.

tokens.name: bg-selected
tokens.usage: Selected list row and selected tab. Hover uses bg-muted. Measured from the selected sidebar row.

tokens.name: bg-input
tokens.usage: Fill of inputs and text areas, matching the message composer: white in light, the composer's grey in dark.

tokens.name: bg-selection
tokens.usage: The one selected row in a file list or record list, with on-selection text. Measured #348ede from the viewer's file list. White on it is 3.4:1, under 4.5:1 for small text: kept to match the viewer. Dark assumed.

tokens.name: on-selection
tokens.usage: Text and icons on bg-selection.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Inputs, bordered buttons, tags. Measured from the message composer.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and panes, card outlines. Measured #ededeb to #efefef.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Hovered border, the rule beside a quote. Measured from the quote rule.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body and UI text on bg, bg-sidebar, bg-muted, bg-button and bg-selected.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Meta, labels, counts, section headings in a rail. On bg, bg-sidebar and bg-muted (4.6:1 or better). Measured #767676, darkened one step to pass on bg-muted.

tokens.name: text-placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholder text only. Below 4.5:1 by design, as in the app; never use for content.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links in running text, on bg and bg-muted. Measured #2e67a3 in light; dark set so it shows as the chat's #8cb4dc in the pane.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset. 3:1 on every ground. Measured from the app's progress spinner.

tokens.name: strong
tokens.usage: Fill of a pressed toggle and the one primary button per view.

tokens.name: on-strong
tokens.usage: Text on strong.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Approved, added, done: fills, bars and the + count. The app's own diff green (#1f9643, measured). White text on it is 4:1, under 4.5:1 for small text: kept exact to match the app.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Removed, rejected, error: text, fills and the − count. The app's own diff red, measured from its removed-line count.

tokens.name: on-status
tokens.usage: Text on a success or danger fill.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of inserted words, like the app's added-word highlight (#d6e9d8 on white).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of deleted words, like the app's removed-line tint (#fff2f2 on white).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: In motion: the dot, tag and progress for work under way (in progress, in review). Amber, so red stays 'needs you' and grey stays 'parked'; a grey in-progress dot read as nothing happening. Same values as Kelvin App, chosen there from three options on 29 Oct 2026.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a warning tag.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Workspace preset only. The viewer's display serif is proprietary; Source Serif 4 is the closest free match.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One title at the top of a Workspace panel. Measured: 26px cap height.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: One family. The app's own face is proprietary; Figtree at weight 450 is the closest free match by width, x-height and color. The app renders running text at 16px.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Which of these should ship this week?

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section and item headings. Same size as body, set apart by weight, as the app does.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: I moved the setup steps into one list and cut the intro.
styles.usage: Running text. Measured: 16px with a 24px line, matching the app's file viewer and chat text width.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Secondary lines, counts, rail section labels, in text-secondary.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a row, list row gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside cards and inputs, between a label and its control.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones, card padding, between items.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups in a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections; page top padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, small segmented tabs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and list rows. Measured from the sidebar row and update button.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, text areas, quoted blocks. Measured from the message bubble and composer.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Workspace panels on the canvas. Measured from the design system viewer.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Progress bars and count badges only.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons, tabs, list rows. Measured from sidebar row pitch.

tokens.name: control-height-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons (us-btn-sm) in table rows, filter bars and the composer. Matches the tab height inside a tab group.

tokens.name: content-width
tokens.usage: Max width of a report or short page column.

tokens.name: tool-width
tokens.usage: Max width of a tool or tracker.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Rows in a Workspace table. Measured 56px row pitch.

tokens.name: file-row-height
tokens.usage: Rows in a file list: icon, name and a meta line.

tokens.name: nav-width
tokens.usage: The Workspace left nav. Keep it narrow: leave out anything that needs more room, such as a row of filter tabs.

tokens.name: detail-width
tokens.usage: The Workspace detail panel on the right.

tokens.name: list-width
tokens.usage: Default width of a Split list; the reader can drag it from 220 to 560px.

tokens.name: top-bar-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of the bar across the top of a Workspace's main column (the tracker) and the exact height of the nav's top band (us-nav-top), so their bottom hairlines meet in one line. A 32px control, 12px above and below, and the 1px hairline.
